newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MAY 14.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MAY 14.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
-- Investors were fighting for MOL shares in Budapest and it was possible that the subscription period will be extended, with subscription likely to be allowed to be lodged in also on Thursday.
-- There will be a NATO military exercise in Hungary this year, participants of a defense conference said.
-- Workers at meat company Szekszardi Husipari Rt will receive their wages for April later today.
-- Boosting economic relations is the main topic at Prime Minister Gyula Horn's visit in east Germany.
-- The EU should recognise differences as soon as possible among applicants to join, said Foreign Minister Laszlo Kovacs.
